title: Signal: Legacy cipher with RUN openssl enc -des -in app.tar -out app.enc (dockerfile) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on an openssl enc invocation.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches the cipher flag; data already encrypted under the old scheme needs a migration plan.

examples.line: # audit: RUN openssl enc -des -in app.tar -out app.enc present
# verified: RUN openssl enc -aes-256-gcm -in app.tar -out app.enc

fpNotes: A command that only decrypts archived data during a one-off migration is the documented exception.
